shoulder_proximal_overlap_center.basis: Rounded shoulder cap center at proximal upper-right end of sleeve; parent independently inspected this region.

elbow_distal_opening_center.basis: Rounded center of distal elbow cuff opening at lower end; parent independently inspected this region.

static_calibration.basis: One measured static uniform transform only; scale maps measured raw endpoint distance to declared 180 source-pixel bone; rotation aligns provisional far upper-arm rest axis; translation pins proximal shoulder to core cap after accepted core static transform. Must be inspected in 38px assembly; not final motion approval.

limits: Uniform scale/rotation/translation only for this component into rest space. No alpha cleanup, crop, anisotropic stretch, per-frame fit, or motion approval. Inspect actual assembly at fixed 38/1254 and refine only by recorded parent-reviewed evidence.
